svg.title: Backlink Route-Specific Checks
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-backlink-route-specific-checks; chapter number: 5; title: Backlink Route-Specific Checks; subtitle: Domain acquisition, digital PR, and journalist-pitch checks from Grumpy SEO Guy ([ez24lr3G_Mc @ 00:23:17]), Vasco's SEO Tips ([voMel_srl_w @ 00:08:41]), Iron Goo ([Z5OwRBCX5ww @ 00:10:26]), and Visibility on Purpose ([B1uNyKgJlXc @ 00:12:34]).; chart type: decision_tree; note: These are route-specific checks, not a claim that purchasing domains and pitching journalists form one acquisition method. Grumpy SEO Guy ([ez24lr3G_Mc @ 00:05:19]) says not to interlink portfolio sites; Iron Goo ([Z5OwRBCX5ww @ 00:12:13]) says to expect a handful of good links rather than 50 and to judge who linked.; nodes: gate: G1; question: For a portfolio purchase, has domain evidence been compared across tools? [Grumpy SEO Guy — ez24lr3G_Mc @ 00:23:17]; pass next: G2 for archived-history inspection; retain the speaker's DR 10 to 40 acquisition range. [Grumpy SEO Guy — ez24lr3G_Mc @ 00:35:45]; fail action: Compare the domain evidence across tools before buying. [Grumpy SEO Guy — ez24lr3G_Mc @ 00:23:17]; gate: G2; question: Has archived history been inspected for an earlier casino or adult identity behind a rebrand? [Vasco's SEO Tips — voMel_srl_w @ 00:08:41]; pass next: Evaluate the domain with its history visible, rather than accepting current metrics alone. [Vasco's SEO Tips — voMel_srl_w @ 00:08:41]; fail action: Inspect archived history before accepting the domain. [Vasco's SEO Tips — voMel_srl_w @ 00:08:41]; gate: G3; question: For digital PR, are the survey, numbers, and expert real rather than invented? [Iron Goo — Z5OwRBCX5ww @ 00:10:26]; pass next: Use a headline-like finding, method line, full-data access, and quotable source. [Iron Goo — Z5OwRBCX5ww @ 00:06:32]; fail action: Do not fill the campaign with fabricated research or a nonexistent expert. [Iron Goo — Z5OwRBCX5ww @ 00:10:26]; gate: G4; question: For HARO or Qwoted, is the answer personalized rather than AI-written? [Visibility on Purpose — B1uNyKgJlXc @ 00:12:34]; pass next: Pitch material relevant to the subject matter and the source's expertise. [Julian Goldie SEO — LY7IFzytdLo @ 00:03:36]; fail action: Personalize the answer; distinguish grammar review from having AI write the pitch. [Visibility on Purpose — B1uNyKgJlXc @ 00:12:34]
